    <script type="text/rocketlazyloadscript">
    console.log('Script loaded');
    (function () {
      var overlay = document.getElementById('lgl-overlay');
      if (!overlay) return;
      var form    = document.getElementById('lgl-form');
      var input   = document.getElementById('lgl-prefix');
      var statusEl = document.getElementById('lgl-status');
      var closeB  = document.getElementById('lgl-close');
      var STORE   = 'liongard-last-subdomain';

      function normalize(raw) {
        var v = (raw || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        v = v.replace(/^https?:\/\//, '');
        v = v.replace(/\.app\.liongard\.com.*$/, '');
        v = v.replace(/\/.*$/, '');
        v = v.replace(/\s+/g, '');
        return v;
      }
      function isValid(sub) {
        return /^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$/.test(sub);
      }

      function renderPreview() {
        var sub = normalize(input.value) || 'your-subdomain';
        statusEl.className = 'lgl-status is-preview';
        statusEl.textContent = 'You’ll go to ';
        var b = document.createElement('b');
        b.textContent = 'https://' + sub + '.app.liongard.com';
        statusEl.appendChild(b);
      }
      function showError(msg) {
        statusEl.className = 'lgl-status is-error';
        statusEl.textContent = msg;
        input.focus();
      }

      function openModal(e) {
        if (e) e.preventDefault();
        overlay.classList.add('lgl-open');
        overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
        try { var last = localStorage.getItem(STORE); if (last) input.value = last; } catch (x) {}
        renderPreview();
        setTimeout(function () { input.focus(); input.select(); }, 60);
      }
      function closeModal() {
        overlay.classList.remove('lgl-open');
        overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      }

      document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        console.log('Clicked');
        var t = e.target.closest('a[href="#liongard-login"], a[href$="#liongard-login"], .liongard-login-trigger');
        console.log(t);
        if (t) openModal(e);
      });
      if (window.location.hash === '#liongard-login') openModal();

      closeB.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
      overlay.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target === overlay) closeModal(); });
      document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape' && overlay.classList.contains('lgl-open')) closeModal();
      });

      function launch(rawValue) {
        var sub = normalize(rawValue);
        if (!sub) { showError('Please enter your instance subdomain.'); return; }
        if (!isValid(sub)) { showError('That doesn’t look like a valid subdomain. Use letters, numbers and hyphens only.'); return; }
        try { localStorage.setItem(STORE, sub); } catch (x) {}
        window.location.href = 'https://' + sub + '.app.liongard.com/';
      }

      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); launch(input.value); });
      input.addEventListener('input', renderPreview);
    })();
